title: Odysseus Plugin Manifest
description: Manifest for an Odysseus plugin. Plugins are pip-installed, out-of-tree Python packages that extend Odysseus via a register(host) hook.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema for IDE autocomplete and CI linting.

entry_point.description: Dotted path to the register(host) callable, e.g. 'my_plugin:register'.

odysseus_compat.description: Version range of Odysseus this plugin is compatible with, e.g. '>=0.1.0'.

description.description: Short human-readable description of the plugin.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or custom license name.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities this plugin requires. Ordinary capabilities are self-serve; privileged capabilities require explicit operator opt-in.

frontend.description: Optional path (relative to plugin package root) to the frontend JavaScript module, loaded in-process when the plugin is enabled.

styles.description: Optional CSS files to inject into the main app page.
